verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs describe a built-in agent in the web editor. Users can delegate it work: writing content, editing pages, reorganizing navigation, updating docs.json, searching the repository and managing dashboard settings. The Mintlify agent also researches, plans and writes documentation, then opens pull requests for review. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated agent tasks work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The editor includes a built-in agent that can edit pages, reorganize navigation, update `docs.json`, search across your entire repository, and manage dashboard settings.
Use the editor's built-in AI agent to write content, edit pages, leave comments and suggestions, search your site, upload files, and configure settings.
Learn how the Mintlify agent researches, plans, and writes documentation, then opens pull requests with proposed changes for your team to review.
